modelOverview: First created by Louis Cartier in 1922 as a refinement of his original 1917 Tank design, the Tank Louis Cartier is the dressiest, most historically faithful expression of the Tank line: a solid-gold, gently curved rectangular case on an integrated bracelet or strap. It is powered exclusively by Cartier's slim in-house manual-winding movements, keeping the case thin and the silhouette true to Louis Cartier's original proportions.

WGTA0023.movement: Manual winding · Cartier Calibre 1917 MC · ~38h power reserve
WGTA0023.materials: 18K rose (pink) gold case on a matching 18K rose gold bracelet
WGTA0023.dial: Silvered dial with painted Roman numerals, railway minute track and blued-steel sword-shaped hands
WGTA0023.description: The small-model Tank Louis Cartier in rose gold is the archetypal 'Louis Cartier' shrunk to its most elegant proportions, pairing a silvered dial and blued-steel hands with an integrated rose-gold bracelet rather than the more common leather strap. It houses Cartier's slim in-house manual Calibre 1917 MC, keeping the case thin and true to Louis Cartier's 1922 original. Every piece we offer is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.

variants.Yellow Gold – Silver: Small-model Tank Louis Cartier as verified against official specifications: 18K rose (pink) gold case and bracelet with a silvered dial, blued-steel sword hands and beaded, sapphire-set crown, on Cartier's slim manual Calibre 1917 MC.

WGTA0091.movement: Manual winding · Cartier Calibre 1917 MC · 19 jewels · ~38h power reserve

WGTA0091.description: The larger Tank Louis Cartier in yellow gold pairs a striking black lacquer dial with gold-finish hands, giving the classic 1922 silhouette a bolder, more graphic reading than the silvered-dial versions. It is fitted on a black alligator strap with a matching gold ardillon buckle and is powered by Cartier's slim manual Calibre 1917 MC. Every piece we offer is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.
